blocks.label: Public Read
blocks.body: A red-bearded dwarf lapidarian grins at the workbench, turquoise beads in the beard, green stone chips on the sleeve, and a jeweler's confidence in every finger.

blocks.label: Comes Across As
blocks.body: Swagger built on real skill and a stubborn conscience. Counts honest commissions in beard-beads, and has fewer beads than stories, which tells you something. Wants beautiful things to survive ugly ownership.
